capabilities: prototype: verifier-accepted Ethernet IPv4 XDP parser with bounds checks on the recorded CI kernel
prototype: exact IPv4 source-address hash map with 4096-entry capacity
prototype: XDP_DROP only for explicit source-address map matches with action value 1
prototype: unmatched, non-IPv4, VLAN-tagged, IPv6, malformed, and unsupported paths return XDP_PASS
prototype: offline versioned IPv4 ingress rule validation and deterministic map-update preview
verified in CI: map update and synthetic BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN checks for drop and pass paths
verified in CI: native driver-mode XDP attach/detach on an isolated veth pair with separate network namespaces
verified in CI: actual ICMP pass, exact-source drop, alternate-source pass, and post-detach pass on the veth datapath
not implemented: operator-facing BPF loader, map updater, approval/rollback controller, or production interface management
not verified: physical NIC/driver compatibility, production host behavior, or cross-kernel support
not implemented: IPv6, VLAN parsing, CIDR, transport ports, counters, or rate limiting
negative_scope: fabricated or simulated live operational evidence

platforms.target: Ubuntu 24.04 GitHub Actions runner, x86_64, kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws, Clang 18.1.3, bpftool 7.7.0, veth native XDP
platforms.notes: Kernel verifier accepted the program. Synthetic BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN and driver-mode attach/detach on an isolated veth pair passed. Actual ICMP traffic was observed passing, dropping on the configured source, and passing again after detach.

platforms.target: Other Linux kernels, physical NICs, drivers, hardware, and production interface attachment
platforms.notes: Not tested. No broad kernel, NIC, or driver compatibility claim is made.

build: bpftool 7.7.0 for CI verifier and datapath tests
iproute2 and iputils-ping for CI veth tests
runtime: Python standard library for offline rule validation and map preview; no operator-facing loader or map-update utility is included

interfaces: BPF map: deny_src_ipv4, BPF_MAP_TYPE_HASH, 4096 entries, network-order IPv4 key, one-byte action value
Versioned JSON IPv4 ingress rule schema v1.0
CI-only BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN and native XDP veth attach/detach integration test

claims.claim: Twelve deterministic rule-validation and map-preview unit tests on Python 3.9 through 3.13 on Ubuntu 24.04.
BPF object compiles with Clang 18.1.3 and contains xdp, .maps, and license ELF sections.
Kernel BPF verifier acceptance, map update, and synthetic BPF_PROG_TEST_RUN cases on Ubuntu 24.04 kernel 7.0.0-1014-aws.
Native XDP driver-mode attach/detach and ICMP pass/drop/restore behavior on an isolated veth pair in separate network namespaces.
Physical NIC/driver compatibility, production interface behavior, and cross-kernel support.
